description: Every other Reddit post that shares this post's link: the list Reddit shows on a post's "other discussions" tab, across all subreddits, so every conversation about one article, video or product page can be read, not only the first thread found. Returns the original `post`, `duplicates` (up to 100 in one read, not paged, `after` is null) and `available` (how many Reddit returned). A made-up or removed post id is a 404 NOT_FOUND. A text post usually has none.

crossposts_only.description: true returns only crossposts and leaves out independent submissions of the same URL.

id.description: Reddit post id, e.g. '1sgjld3'. A t3_ prefix is optional.

sort.description: num_comments (default, most discussed first) or new.

name: reddit_post_duplicates
title: Get Post Duplicates
